a.speaker: harcourt
a.text: Okay... okay. You win. Look at you. Tommy always said you were the talented one.

c.speaker: harcourt
c.text: I held the fire extinguisher on set. The empty one. Nobody told me it was empty. I swear to God.

d.speaker: harcourt
d.text: Somebody wanted that shot, kid. The real one. They're still paying for it. They're paying for THIS.

s1.speaker: cass
s1.text: Tell whoever's paying: I'm not acting.
